script:
Bai Patient
I've had congenital heart disease since childhood. My mother died of a heart attack when giving birth to me. My father raised me alone. Although he was busy with work and had no time to accompany me, I don't blame him. He worked so hard to earn money for my treatment. By 2017, I finally found a suitable heart source. I overheard my father talking with Deputy Director Pan about purchasing a suitable heart through unconventional means. For my heart, my father spent all the family savings and even sold our house. I must recover quickly so my father can depend on me in the future.
In September 2017, three days before the heart transplant surgery, I was suddenly notified of cancellation. Deputy Director Pan returned the 500,000 yuan for purchasing the organ. This was like a bolt from the blue for my father and me. All hope collapsed in an instant. Although we had a contract, I knew after reading it that it was completely invalid. My father had a stroke from anger and left me just like that. I must find out why all this happened.
When I was most desperate, I met Wei Daughter. Her quirky appearance was etched in my heart. The first time I met her, she came out of Director Zhen's office with red eyes and a sad face, but we didn't know each other then, so I didn't ask her. I was carrying an IV bottle, preparing to return to my room, when she saw me and came over to help me carry the IV bottle back.
We got to know each other this way. She knew my surgery was cancelled and kept comforting me. I could feel she wasn't as carefree as she appeared on the surface. But I'm a person with no future; I can't delay her. I keep a few photos of us together on my phone. Looking at them when I'm sad gives me great encouragement.
On January 26th, I went to find Deputy Director Pan to get answers, but he wasn't there. So I went into his office and searched through his desk, actually finding organ transaction contracts between Deputy Director Pan and other patients' families. I took the contracts. Looking through them back home, I found Director Zhen's transaction contract with Deputy Director Pan in the contracts. Seeing the transaction time, content (heart), and price (800,000 yuan), I knew Director Zhen had stolen my heart! This Director Zhen, who relied on money to steal my hope of survival and take my father's life, and the profit-driven, promise-breaking Deputy Director Pan - both deserve to die!
After discharge, my condition worsened more frequently. At this time, Nurse Wang from the hospital found me, saying she could secretly sell pain-relief sedatives at low prices. I agreed.
Then I began hiring private investigators to investigate Director Zhen. Unexpectedly, he turned out to be Wei Daughter's stepfather and had been abusing her, and was related to her biological father's surgical failure. He used various means to escape accountability for several medical accidents. He's treacherous and evil. My father's death was also caused by him. He stole the survival rights that originally belonged to me. Even if it was for his mother, it's unforgivable. Such a person doesn't deserve to live in this world. I can't just leave like this. I want to take away a scumbag and help Wei Daughter escape!
[February 3rd - Night of the Incident]
This was Director Zhen's scheduled night duty day, so I decided to act that night.
20:40 - I arrived near the hospital to get the black clothes and dagger I ordered on the black market, but I saw Wei Daughter entering the hospital from afar. She must be looking for Director Zhen. I couldn't act rashly with her there, so I called to postpone the transaction by forty minutes.
21:15 - I saw Wei Daughter enter a coffee shop near the hospital, so I rushed to the transaction location.
21:20 - After getting the black clothes and dagger I bought, I immediately returned to the hospital to implement my plan.
21:35-21:50 - I came to the separate power room behind the hospital and pried open the door lock. I found the second-floor power line and cut it with the dagger. The second floor of the hospital has no patients, so a power outage wouldn't be urgently repaired. I'm not a stranger in the hospital, so entering rashly would easily get me recognized. Cutting the power line to sneak into the office in darkness was the best method.
22:00 - I came to the second floor, which was basically pitch black. I took out my flashlight and went to Director Zhen's office. I saw him lying on the desk with a pool of fresh blood on the floor and an inconspicuous wound at the heart position. I shook his shoulder, but he didn't move. I felt his carotid artery - no response. He was dead. So I still followed my original plan, dragging him to Deputy Director Pan's office door (also on the second floor), used the dagger to cut open his chest, removed the heart, and put it in the black bag I prepared. Such a person's heart must be black! No! He doesn't deserve to have a healthy heart. Deputy Director Pan is no good either - framing him kills two birds with one stone.
22:15 - I quickly left Health Hospital and threw the plastic bag containing the heart into a garbage bin outside the hospital. Taking advantage of the dark night with no one around, I took off the black clothes and walked near the mall, throwing the bloody black clothes and dagger into a garbage bin.
acts_goal: Find the real culprit of this case, try to hide the fact that you removed the heart.
